item.description: The effect module is missing async_result and async_option builders that are referenced in the failing tests. Tests expect these to be available as effect.async_result and effect.async_option.
item.contract: Add async_result and async_option builders to the effect module's public interface. These should be implemented as async versions of the existing ResultBuilder and OptionBuilder classes, following the same pattern as the existing seq builder.

item.description: The _send method in the Builder class has an issue with list_iterator objects not having a send method, causing AttributeError when using seq builder with certain operations.
item.contract: Modify the _send method to properly handle list_iterator objects and other iterables that may not have a send method by checking the type of the yielded value before attempting to send to it.

item.description: The ResultBuilder class has a NotImplementedError for the zero() method, which is required by the async_result builder tests.
item.contract: Implement the zero() method in ResultBuilder to return Ok(None) as expected by the tests.
